paragraphs.speaker: Bob
paragraphs.text: We opened with customer sentiment. The pilot accounts like the staged rollout but want fewer surprise emails.

paragraphs.speaker: Maya
paragraphs.text: Design reviewed the empty-state mocks. The room agreed the current version is acceptable for launch.

paragraphs.speaker: Omar
paragraphs.text: Performance charts looked noisy because the replay job overlapped with staging traffic.

paragraphs.speaker: Alice
paragraphs.text: Alice mentioned she'd follow up on the vendor quote once procurement sends the updated line items.

paragraphs.speaker: Diana
paragraphs.text: Support expects a small spike on the first morning but no weekend coverage change.

paragraphs.speaker: George
paragraphs.text: Northstar asked about self-serve billing, which remains out of scope for this pilot.

paragraphs.speaker: Fatima
paragraphs.text: The docs redirect plan was discussed, mostly to avoid linking customers into the preview site.

paragraphs.speaker: Eli
paragraphs.text: Regression coverage is good for Chrome and Safari, but Firefox screenshots are still pending comparison.

paragraphs.speaker: Nora
paragraphs.text: Backend agreed to validate the webhook contract against staging before the partner demo.

paragraphs.speaker: Bob
paragraphs.text: The launch calendar stays unchanged unless legal blocks the customer email.

paragraphs.speaker: Maya
paragraphs.text: Could the color palette be calmer? The group treated that as feedback, not a launch blocker.

paragraphs.speaker: Omar
paragraphs.text: There was a short aside about whether p95 should be shown in the exec readout.

paragraphs.speaker: Charlie
paragraphs.text: EMEA localization is deferred because the initial cohort is US-only.

paragraphs.speaker: Bob
paragraphs.text: The team agreed to defer the data migration to Q2 and publish a short risk note for leadership.

paragraphs.speaker: Diana
paragraphs.text: No new escalation path is needed for customer success.

paragraphs.speaker: George
paragraphs.text: The client sponsor likes the dashboard but wants clearer terminology around import errors.

paragraphs.speaker: Alice
paragraphs.text: We revisited API freeze timing and kept noon Eastern as the cutoff.

paragraphs.speaker: Diana
paragraphs.text: Diana will circulate the revised onboarding checklist after support reviews the examples.

paragraphs.speaker: Fatima
paragraphs.text: Docs owner said the screenshots are fine once the banner text changes.

paragraphs.speaker: Eli
paragraphs.text: Why do demos always find the one path QA did not click? The room laughed and moved on.

paragraphs.speaker: Omar
paragraphs.text: Performance budget remains at 800ms for the first contentful panel.

paragraphs.speaker: Bob
paragraphs.text: The group decided not to add a second launch email.

paragraphs.speaker: Eli
paragraphs.text: QA needs to rerun the regression pack after the feature flag is enabled.

paragraphs.speaker: Maya
paragraphs.text: Design can live with the current icon set until the next release.

paragraphs.speaker: Charlie
paragraphs.text: Partner enablement has the same deck as sales, so no new artifact is required.

paragraphs.speaker: George
paragraphs.text: The client escalation contact is unchanged.

paragraphs.speaker: Nora
paragraphs.text: Backend noted that the webhook retry policy is already documented.

paragraphs.speaker: Bob
paragraphs.text: Product should collect beta feedback from Northstar and Atlas before the roadmap review.

paragraphs.speaker: Fatima
paragraphs.text: The meeting closed with thanks and a reminder to keep updates in the launch channel.

paragraphs.speaker: Alice
paragraphs.text: Next readiness review remains on the calendar for Monday morning.
